title: Point legacy /blogs and /knowledge redirects at blog.biyani.xyz and kb.biyani.xyz once live
description: When the new sites are live: change the case-study redirects to external ones (location.replace to the matching article/term URL where a mapping exists), update the case-study links and the specs' redirect rows. Consider an Ask tool that queries the KB search API (cross-project integration).
acceptance_criteria: Old /blogs/:id and /knowledge/glossary links land on the corresponding page of the new site.

title: Create the blog and kb repos from the holding content
description: New repos (e.g. biyani701/blog, biyani701/kb) with their own architecture, README, deploy and beads (bd init). Blog: a proper blogging tool (editor, drafts, publish) seeded with the 3 articles. KB: Neon Postgres (via Vercel Marketplace) with full-text search and an API, seeded with the 68 glossary terms and the knowledge topics; the 3-D Secure flow as an interactive page. Subdomains blog.biyani.xyz, kb.biyani.xyz. Tracked here only as the hand-off; work continues in those repos.
acceptance_criteria: Both repos exist with seed content and their own issue tracking.

title: After legacy cut-over, retire the portfolio client in apps/auth-server
description: apps/portfolio still uses apps/auth-server (deploy-portfolio.yml REACT_APP_AUTH_SERVER_URL), so keep it until P14.4 removes apps/portfolio. Then: remove ClientId.PORTFOLIO and the vishal.biyani.xyz/github.io origin match in apps/auth-server/src/auth.config.ts, the GITHUB_CLIENT_ID_PORTFOLIO/SECRET env vars on Vercel, and the GitHub/Google OAuth apps registered for the portfolio. Decide then whether apps/auth-server moves to the new showcase repo.
acceptance_criteria: auth-server no longer recognises the portfolio origin; the portfolio OAuth apps are deleted or repurposed.
